avis.titre: The ONLY product that worked for me!aszzas
avis.texte: For context: I have very oily scalp and very dry ends. Like if I don't wash my hair in 3 days, my scalp gets really stinky and my roots flat. I also have very long hair that reaches down to my butt. The problem with the shampoos I've used before is that they clean my scalp really good but then leave my hair especially the ends dry and rough. I developed this big and crusty flakes that caused redness in my scalp and every time I scratch, I would scrape off chunks of build ups. Also, even after a thorough wash when I scratch my scalp, tiny flakes would come off. It was so bad so I tried everything from heavily medicated anti dandruff shampoos, Head and shoulders, dove, salon/ professional grade shampoos, nothing would work. They would either make my scalp so dry and tight? and my hair so lifeless and DRY!! Nothing helped with the flakiness, the oiliness and persistent itching till I used this product. It has a scent to it but nothing overpowering. I wash my hair 2-3x a week focusing on my scalp, and I also use a scalp massager/ shampooing brush. I use just enough to make a really good lather (this product lathers very good) and I make sure to let it sit for 2-5 minutes before rinsing it off with lukewarm water. I also make sure to dry my scalp and hair really good and not go to sleep with wet hair!! I've been using this product for a month now and I just can't thank this product enough for fixing my scalp. No more small flakes, no more chunky yucky build up, no more itch and re

I’ve had an itchy scalp for years and nothing has worked. Two days later I used it again and the itch was totally gone! I also used the conditioner and my normally dry, frizzy hair was frizz-free and looked much better! It’s been three days since I shampooed and no itch but I will use again this a.m. I am very happy with the results and will definitely continue using. You can use this 2-3 times a week. The one drawback is the smell, really awful and for me I could smell it for most of the first day. Then it faded away. But, it’s so effective it’s a no-brainer, it’s worth it. Oh, almost forgot. I used it on my eyebrows and face and it worked on those areas as well. 😀

avis.titre: Made My Symptoms Worse and Lost Half My Hair
avis.texte: I initially endured a scalp-burning sensation, mistakenly believing it meant the product was working to cure my flakes and itch. Weeks later, the extreme itching became intolerable. After a single month of use, I was left with severe hair loss, losing approximately half my hair, and noticing alarming bald spots forming throughout my scalp. My remaining hair is brittle and dry, and the original itch is now far worse than when I started.

I’ve been using this Vichy Dercos Selenium Sulfide Anti-Dandruff Shampoo and it has honestly made a huge difference in my scalp health. It controls my dandruff incredibly well — better than many other products I’ve tried — and the results were noticeable within just a few washes. My scalp feels soothed, clean, and refreshed every time I use it, and the itching I used to deal with has almost completely disappeared. What I appreciate the most is that it targets both the visible flakes and the recurrence of dandruff, so it doesn’t just mask the problem — it actually helps prevent it from coming back. The formula feels gentle on the scalp yet very effective, and it also strengthens my hair without drying it out. I also love that it’s safe for sensitive scalps and color-treated hair, which gives me confidence using it regularly. Overall, this shampoo has become an essential part of my routine, and I truly recommend it to anyone struggling with dandruff or itchy scalp.
